title: covsight example expectations (expect.yaml)
description: What an example's coverage run should produce. Read by the covsight.Check and covsight.Show dv-flow tasks. covsight.dvflow.expect validates the same rules and reports file:line errors.

totals.description: covered/total per coverage kind; kinds left out are not checked.

transcript.description: covsight commands (without the database argument) whose output goes in the docs, in order.

parity.description: Known differences from verilator_coverage --report summary, per kind, each with its reason.

warnings.description: Regular expressions for the Verilator build warnings this example expects. Any other warning fails the check.
